title: Request a Dental Consultation
description: Choose a consultation location, appointment type, and preferred date, then briefly describe your concern. A chamber team member confirms availability with you before any appointment is finalized.
successMessage: Thank you. Your appointment request has been received. A chamber team member will contact you to confirm availability.

consultationTypes.label: New appointment
consultationTypes.description: For first-time consultation, diagnosis, treatment planning, or a new dental concern.

consultationTypes.label: Follow-up
consultationTypes.description: For review after an earlier consultation, treatment visit, or prescribed care plan.

consultationTypes.label: Telemedicine
consultationTypes.description: For remote guidance when an in-person examination is not immediately required.

consultationTypes.label: Report review
consultationTypes.description: For reviewing X-rays, prescriptions, referral notes, or previous treatment documents.
